app.name: LabConnect
app.footer: LabConnect · operated under QCI branding (interim). Endorsement wording to be confirmed.

home.title: Find an accredited lab for your test
home.intro: Search NABL-accredited testing laboratories by test, product, standard or lab. See prices and turnaround, and book a drop-off slot.
home.calibrationNote: Calibration labs are listed, but you can't book them on LabConnect yet.

search.textPlaceholder: For example: tensile strength, cement, IS 1608
search.locationDenied: Location is off for this site. Allow it in the browser to sort labs by distance.
search.pincodeSoon: Search by PIN code is coming soon. Use your location for now.
search.countDistance: {count} labs on this page · sorted by distance. LabConnect doesn't rank labs as "best".
search.countRelevance: {count} labs on this page. LabConnect doesn't rank labs as "best".
search.mapLabel: Map of the labs on this page
search.mapUnavailable: The map is not available in this browser. The list shows every lab.
search.listedNote: Prices and slots appear once the lab joins.
search.noResultsText: Try a wider radius or fewer filters, or ask us to bring a lab on board.
search.errorText: Something went wrong on our side. Your search is kept.

lab.verify: Verify on the accreditation body's website
lab.scopeSearchLabel: Search the accredited tests at this site
lab.priceListNote: Prices from published list v{version} · effective {date}
lab.gstNote: Prices exclude GST ({rate}%). The lab confirms the final price when it accepts your request.
lab.requirementsNone: The lab has not published sample requirements.
lab.noPin: The lab's location on the map is being checked.
lab.listedText: This lab is accredited but hasn't joined LabConnect yet, so prices, slots and online booking aren't available.
lab.calibrationText: LabConnect books testing only for now. You can see this lab's calibration scope, but you can't book it here yet.
lab.bookingSoon: Online booking opens in the next release. Prices and slots shown here are the lab's published ones.
lab.errorText: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again.

lead.introLab: {lab} is listed but can't take bookings yet. Tell us you need it and we'll contact the lab.
lead.titleNoResult: Ask us to find a lab
lead.introNoResult: Tell us what you need tested. We'll let you know when a lab can do it.
lead.whatHelp: Your search is filled in for you.
lead.emailHelp: We'll write when the lab joins. We don't share your email with the lab.
lead.sentText: We'll email you if the lab joins or we find another lab.
lead.errorEmail: Enter a full email address, like name@company.in.
lead.errorWhat: Tell us which test you need.
lead.failed: The request could not be sent. Please try again.
lead.rateLimited: Too many requests. Try again in a few minutes. Your text is kept.
lead.labNotFound: This lab can't be requested. Search again to find it.

auth.title: Sign in to LabConnect
auth.intro: Sign in to continue. You'll come back to the same page.
auth.emailHelp: We'll email you a 6-digit code. There is no password.
auth.codeSent: Code sent to {email}. It works for 10 minutes.
auth.codeInvalid: That code didn't match. Check the email and try again.
auth.codeExpired: This code has expired. Send a new one.
auth.locked: Sign-in for this email is paused until {time}.
auth.lockedNoTime: Sign-in for this email is paused for a while. Try again later.
auth.rateLimitedNoTime: Wait a few minutes before asking again.
auth.emailInvalid: Enter a full email address, like name@company.in.
auth.failed: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again.
auth.mfaIntro: Your role needs a second step. Enter the code from your authenticator app.
auth.mfaInvalid: That code didn't match. Check your phone's time is set automatically.
auth.mfaLocked: Try again at {time}. Lost your phone? Contact LabConnect support. They will check who you are before an administrator resets it.
auth.mfaLockedNoTime: Try again later. Lost your phone? Contact LabConnect support. They will check who you are before an administrator resets it.
auth.enrolText: Your role needs a second step and you haven't set one up yet. Setting it up on the web comes in the next release; ask LabConnect support in the meantime.
auth.sessionEnded: You were signed out after a period without activity. Sign in again to carry on.

signUp.title: Create your LabConnect account
signUp.emailIntro: Enter your work email. We'll email you a code. There is no password.
signUp.organisationHelp: Company, institution or government body; GSTIN on invoices
signUp.fullNameHelp: Used as the name on reports and invoices.
signUp.errorGstinLength: A GSTIN has 15 characters. This one has {count}.
signUp.errorGstinFormat: This isn't a valid GSTIN. Check it against your GST certificate.
signUp.errorGstinTaken: Another customer account already uses this GSTIN. Ask its administrator to invite you.
signUp.failed: Something went wrong on our side. Nothing was saved. Try again.
signUp.signedOut: Your session has ended. Sign in again to finish creating your account.
signUp.forbidden: This account can't create a customer organisation.
signUp.doneText: You can book a test now. Nothing to pay until a lab accepts.
signUp.alreadyTitle: You already have a customer account
signUp.alreadyText: You're signed in to {organisation}. Find a lab to book a test.
signUp.staffText: Platform staff accounts can't join a customer organisation.

enrol.title: Set up your authenticator
enrol.signInText: Your role needs a second step at sign-in and you haven't set one up yet. It takes about two minutes.
enrol.whyTitle: Your role needs a second step
enrol.whyText: Lab Checkers, Customer Finance and every platform role confirm sign-in and sensitive actions with a code from an authenticator app. You scan a code once, then enter a new code each time you sign in.
enrol.restartWarning: If you start again, the setup key you had before stops working. Remove the old entry from your app and use the new one.
enrol.scanTitle: Scan this with your authenticator app
enrol.scanText: Use any authenticator app you trust. LabConnect will appear as an account.
enrol.qrLabel: QR code for your authenticator app. If you can't scan it, type the setup key below.
enrol.keyLabel: Can't scan? Type this setup key
enrol.codeHelp: 6 digits. If you set up in more than one window, only the key from the latest one works.
enrol.codeInvalid: That code didn't match. Wait for a new code and try again.
enrol.lockedNoTime: Wait a few minutes, then try again.
enrol.rateLimited: Too many requests. Try again at {time}.
enrol.rateLimitedNoTime: Too many requests. Try again in a few minutes.
enrol.failed: Something went wrong on our side. Try again.
enrol.alreadyTitle: Your second step is already on
enrol.alreadyText: An authenticator is already set up for your account. Sign in and enter the code from your app.
enrol.lostText: If you lost your authenticator, contact LabConnect support: only a Platform Admin can reset it.
enrol.noPendingText: This set-up is finished or was replaced. Sign in and enter the code from your app. Recovery codes are shown only once and can't be shown again; if you didn't save them, contact LabConnect support.
enrol.codesWarning: Save these now. 10 single-use codes. We won't show them again. Each one works once if you lose your authenticator.
enrol.saveFirst: Tick the box to confirm you saved your recovery codes.
enrol.afterText: Your second step is on. Setting it up does not sign you in: next you sign in again with an email code and then a code from your app.

access.signInText: This page is for signed-in users. Sign in and you'll come back to this page.
access.deniedTitle: You don't have access to this page
access.deniedText: This page is for {needed}. Your role is {current}.
access.deniedNoRole: This page is for {needed}. You aren't acting for an organisation with a role.
access.deniedHelp: If you need it, ask a Platform Admin.
access.unavailableText: LabConnect did not answer. Try again in a moment.

claim.title: Claim your lab on LabConnect
claim.intro: You're setting up the lab as its first user. You'll be its Checker. A Maker joins later.
claim.memberOf: You are in this lab as {role}.
claim.staffTitle: Platform staff can't claim a lab
claim.staff: Platform accounts review claims; they can't make one. Use an account of the lab for the claim.
claim.certHelp: Find your lab with the number on your NABL certificate. We send a code to the email NABL has on record for it.
claim.certInvalid: Enter the certificate number, up to 50 characters.
claim.notFound: We couldn't find a lab with this certificate. Check the number, or ask LabConnect support to add your lab.
claim.claimed: Someone from your lab has set it up. Ask your lab's Checker to invite you.
claim.otherOpenTitle: A claim for this lab is already open
claim.otherOpen: Another person has started a claim for this lab. Try again later, or contact LabConnect support.
claim.ownReviewTitle: Your claim is already in review
claim.ownReview: You already sent a claim for this lab, and LabConnect is checking it.
claim.capStart: You can have {claims} open claims at a time. Wait for a decision, or let an unfinished one expire, then try again.
claim.cap: You've reached a limit on this claim. Contact LabConnect support if you need help.
claim.rateLimited: Too many codes were requested. Try again at {time}.
claim.rateLimitedNoTime: Too many requests. Try again in a few minutes.
claim.signedOut: Sign in again to carry on. You'll come back to this page.
claim.failed: We couldn't reach LabConnect. Try again.
claim.noClaims: You haven't started a claim yet.
claim.unknown: It isn't one of your claims, or it doesn't exist.
claim.reviewNext: We don't email you about the decision yet. Come back to this page: it shows the decision, and the reason if the claim is rejected.
claim.rejectedNext: You can start a new claim for this lab.
claim.expired: A claim that isn't verified within {hours} hours expires.
claim.codeSent: We sent a 6-digit code to the email NABL has on record for this lab: {email}. The code works for 10 minutes.
claim.codeExpired: This code has expired. Send a new one.
claim.locked: Try again at {time}, or claim with a letter on your letterhead.
claim.lockedNoTime: Try again later, or claim with a letter on your letterhead.
claim.changed: This claim changed while the page was open, for example in another tab or window. This is how it stands now.
claim.movedOn: This claim moved on. Reload the page to see where it stands.
claim.noEmail: NABL has no email address on record for this certificate, so we can't send a code. Claim with a letter on your lab's letterhead instead.
claim.letterSummary: Can't reach that inbox? Claim with a letter on your letterhead instead.
claim.letterIntro: Upload a signed letter on your lab's letterhead that names you as authorised to act for the lab. LabConnect reviews it.
claim.letterHelp: PDF, JPEG or PNG, up to {size}. You can upload up to 5 files for one claim.
claim.letterNeedsScript: Uploading a letter needs JavaScript: the file goes straight from your browser to secure storage. Turn it on, or use the email code.
claim.letterType: Upload a PDF, JPEG or PNG file.
claim.letterSize: This file is too big. The most is 10 MB.
claim.letterContent: This file isn't what its name says. Upload a real PDF, JPEG or PNG.
claim.letterRejected: This file wasn't accepted. Upload a PDF, JPEG or PNG of up to 10 MB.
claim.letterCap: You've used all 5 uploads for this claim. Contact LabConnect support.
claim.letterBusy: Too many requests. Try again in a few minutes.
claim.letterNotOpen: This claim is not waiting for a code or a letter any more. Go back to your claims.
claim.letterSendFailed: The file could not be sent. Check your connection and try again.
claim.letterUploaded: We are scanning it for security. You can send the claim for review once the scan is clean.
claim.letterScanning: The scan hasn't finished, or the file was not accepted. Try again in a moment; if it keeps failing, upload a different copy.
claim.listUnavailableTitle: We can't show your claims right now
claim.listUnavailable: LabConnect did not answer. This does not mean you have no claims: try again in a moment.
claim.claimUnavailableTitle: We can't show this claim right now
claim.claimUnavailable: LabConnect did not answer, so we do not know where this claim stands. Try again in a moment.
claim.pageGoneTitle: That page of your claims isn't available
claim.pageGone: The link to it can no longer be read. Start again from the newest claims.
claim.moved: It was not waiting for what you sent. It is now: {status}.
claim.approvedNext: Sign in again. LabConnect will ask you to set up an authenticator app, because a lab Checker needs one. After that you act as this lab's Checker, and the lab is listed under "Your labs" on the claims page.
claim.approvedLater: The screens a Checker works in are not built yet.
claim.rejectedNoReason: LabConnect did not give a reason.
claim.expiredNext: Start a new claim with the certificate number.
claim.resendHelp: Type the certificate number again and we send a new code to the same address. The code you were sent stops working.
claim.resendNotFound: We couldn't find a lab with this certificate. Check the number.

ops.title: Claim requests
ops.intro: Labs whose first user is asking to be made its Checker. Platform Ops decide.
ops.loadFailed: LabConnect did not answer, or the list could not be read.
ops.unknown: It doesn't exist, or it can't be read. Go back to the list.
ops.approvedText: The claimant is now the lab's Checker and will be asked to set up an authenticator at the next sign-in.
ops.rejectedText: The lab user can see your notes and start a new claim.
ops.reviewLetterHelp: Downloads the letter through a link that works for 15 minutes. Every time you open it is recorded.
ops.notWaiting: This claim isn't waiting for a decision. If you came here to decide it, another person may have decided it first.
ops.approveEffect: The claimant becomes this lab's first Checker and the lab becomes claimed. At their next sign-in they must set up an authenticator.
ops.rejectEffect: The lab user sees your notes and can try again.
ops.reasonHelp: Written at the start of the notes.
ops.reasonSignature: Letter not signed by an authorised signatory
ops.notesHelp: Required. The lab user reads this.
ops.notesRequired: Write the notes the lab will see.
ops.notesTooLong: These notes are too long. The most is 2000 characters.
ops.forbidden: Only Platform Ops can approve or reject a claim.
ops.changed: Someone changed this claim after you opened it. Reload it and check before you decide.
ops.decided: This claim isn't waiting for a decision any more. Another person may have decided it first.
ops.busy: This decision is already being made. Wait a moment and reload.
ops.letterheadMissing: This claim was made with a letter, and its letter is missing. It can't be approved.
ops.letterNotReady: The letter isn't ready: its security scan is pending, or it failed. Try again in a moment.
ops.noLetterhead: This claim has no letter. It was verified by email code.
ops.blocked: The claimant can't become this lab's Checker: their account is inactive, is a platform account, already holds a lab role, or is already a member of this lab. Reject the claim and say why.
ops.rateLimited: Too many requests. Try again in a few minutes.
ops.signedOut: Sign in again to carry on. You'll come back to this page.
ops.failed: We couldn't complete that. Reload the claim and try again.
ops.claimantMasked: The claimant's address is masked by LabConnect. Ops cannot see it in full here.
ops.unavailableTitle: We can't show this claim right now
ops.unavailable: LabConnect did not answer, so the claim cannot be shown or decided. Try again in a moment.
ops.blockedLab: The claimant already belongs to a lab. A person holds one lab role, so the approval would be refused. Reject the claim and say why.
ops.blockedPlatform: The claimant belongs to a platform organisation. Platform staff cannot hold a lab role, so the approval would be refused. Reject the claim and say why.
